name: PCK-DataCross Jastrebarsko
notes: Official PCK pages place the operating Jastrebarsko data center in the Jalsevac industrial zone (Cabdin 73, Jastrebarsko), opened 2012-11-22, ~1,300 m2 area for IT equipment, carrier-neutral, EN 50600 certification (PK.1.3.04.0061), redundant 4 MW transformer plants and 4x1.6 MW diesel generators per PCK material; project-level IT load not disclosed. Reassigned to Zagreb County per county-by-physical-site rule.

name: PCK-DataCross Kriz
notes: PCK official site lists the second site (Kriz/Novoselec trade zone, Zagreb County) with construction in planning, up to 1,600 m2 IT space, Tier 4 SLA target 99.995%, 50 km from Zagreb in a different seismic zone, connected by optics to two Zagreb nodes and CIX/VIX/BIX. No official MW value published.

name: Pantheon AI Topusko hyperscale AI data center campus
developer: Pantheon Atlas LLC / Pantheon AI (Koncar and Greenvolt as strategic partners)
notes: Announced 2026-04-28/29: 1 GW total capacity, 800 MW usable IT load, 310-acre site expandable to 450 acres near Topusko (Sisak-Moslavina County), ~EUR 50bn project, construction planned early 2027, full operations targeted Q1 2029. On 2026-07-23 Croatian TSO HOPS accepted the grid-connection elaborate (EOTRP), confirming regulatory-technical power deliverability and starting grid-connection agreement process (tportal/Balkan Green Energy News). BusinessWire release is issuer-controlled; no eDozvola construction permit or EIA document found yet, so grade B pending permit/environmental trail.

name: DC North Varazdin
developer: DC North d.o.o.; now part of Ilkari (exited by CRATIS, June 2026)
notes: Largest carrier-neutral data center in Croatia, opened October 2023 near Varazdin (Poslovna zona Brezje), 12,000 m2 parcel, >2,000 m2 IT space across 6 IT rooms, first phase EUR 17m; Hina/tportal June 2026 report >4 MW installed power while the July 2026 Ilkari spec sheet states 2.8 MW installed capacity supplied via a 4 MW ring; CRATIS exited ownership June 2026 and DC North became part of Ilkari's European sovereign-infrastructure operations. CIX third location operated at DC North since May 2025.

name: HR-ZOO RI Rijeka data center
developer: SRCE / HR-ZOO; University of Rijeka site
notes: Renovated/equipped HR-ZOO RI data center at the University of Rijeka Trsat campus (Radmile Matejcic 2, Rijeka) as part of Croatia's national scientific-educational e-infrastructure; MEP project data list 213 m2 gross area and 125 kW designed DC power; DatacenterMap confirms address.

name: CNRM Bura supercomputer data center, University of Rijeka
developer: Center for Advanced Computing and Modelling (CNRM), University of Rijeka
notes: Official university page: 100 m2 data center room housing the Bura supercomputer with 250 kW installed power supply; academic HPC facility in Rijeka (Primorje-Gorski Kotar County).
